supportedContract.container: Unlocked, uncaptioned, sizeProtect=false body Group at groupLevel=0 with identity rendering matrices and zero container offset, 1..128 direct Rectangle/Ellipse children.
supportedContract.children: Unique non-zero (id, instId) ownership tuple, groupLevel=1, uncaptioned, no textBox, zero rotation/flip, identity scale/shear, integer translation matching hp:offset, axis-aligned rect points or full axis-aligned ellipse axes, bounds contained within parent [0, width] x [0, height].

operations.move: moveGroupChild(sec, para, ctrl, index, expectedId, expectedInstId, x, y) when !child.locked, keeping child inside parent bounds.
operations.resize: resizeGroupChild(sec, para, ctrl, index, expectedId, expectedInstId, width, height) when !child.locked && !child.sizeProtect; left/top-anchored only (UI handles e/se/s), updating orgSz/curSz/common dims, rotation_center, rect pts or ellipse axes/start/end, and clearing raw_rendering so HWPX serialization stays synchronized.

outOfScope: Nested groups or non-Rectangle/Ellipse group children
Rotated, flipped, scaled, sheared, or ambiguous-transform groups or children
Locked parents/children, size-protected parents (or resize of size-protected children)
HWP5 and DOCX group-child geometry editing
